claim_en: THE TENT IS WRITTEN AS HERS, AND THE CORPUS DOES IT EXACTLY FOUR TIMES. At our 12:8 the pitching-verb takes אָהֳלֹה - written with a final HEH where a vav is expected, so the possessive reads HER tent - and the chain draws from it that Sarah's tent was pitched first. Machine-checked at derivation: this spelling stands in the Torah at exactly four seats, all in Genesis - 9:21 (Noah's exposure), our 12:8, 13:3 (the return to the same place), and 35:21 (Israel pitching beyond Migdal Eder). The same anomaly the chain reads as a wife's tent at the first seat it reads as Sarah's precedence here.
middah: ink (her-tent with the final heh, its four seats counted)

claim_en: THE PRIESTLY BLESSING'S OWN WARRANT IS OUR 12:3. R. Akiva's source that those who bless Israel are themselves blessed - priests included - is this verse's 'I will bless those who bless you', and a second Babylonian seat states the rule sharply: any priest who blesses is blessed, and one who does not is not. The same clause carries a cup-of-blessing rule: one handed a cup to bless who declines is punished on this verse's warrant. A promise operator in this unit functions as the standing authority for a live liturgical duty.

check.note: A promise clause operating as the legal warrant for the priestly blessing and for a blessing-obligation at table.

middah: plain (the I-will-bless clause cited as the priestly blessing's warrant)

claim_en: A CEREMONY'S LOCATION IS FIXED BY VERBAL ANALOGY FROM OUR 12:6, AND A RIVAL TEXT IS ADJUDICATED BY IT. The blessings-and-curses ceremony is sited by equating the terebinth of Moreh named in our verse with the one named in the later command - an equal-cut argument, and the Mishnah's case-table records the whole ceremony on that basis, six tribes on each mountain and the Torah written on the stones in seventy languages. The Samaritan text is then charged with having written the place-name INTO its Torah beside the terebinths - 'and you gained nothing, because you do not expound the equal cut; we do, from our verse'. A recorded rival-text variance adjudicated by this unit's own geography token.

check.note: A legal location fixed by gezerah shavah on this verse (middah I2), which then adjudicates a variant text of the corpus itself.

claim_en: 'THE SOULS THEY MADE IN HARAN' IS READ AS A MAKING, AND A GENERAL RULE FOLLOWS. The plural verb is read as conversion - and from it: whoever draws an idolater near and converts him IS AS THOUGH HE CREATED HIM, extended by Reish Lakish to whoever teaches Torah to another's child, whom the verse credits as though he formed him. The plural is read as carrying Sarah's own agency: he converted the men and SHE the women. The same verse anchors the world-era clock, the two thousand years of Torah beginning here.

check.note: A plural verb read as making persons, generating a general rule about conversion and about teaching, and anchoring a chronological frame.

middah: plain (the made-souls verb read as conversion; the rule stated on it)

claim_en: THE WITHHELD DESTINATION IS READ AS A PAYMENT MECHANISM, AND THE DEPARTURE ITSELF AS A LEGAL REMEDY. 'The land that I will show you' conceals the destination deliberately - to endear it, and to pay REWARD PER STRIDE. And the command to go is enrolled as one of the things that annul a decree: change of place, listed beside prayer, charity, repentance, change of name and change of deed, with our verse as the proof and its own recorded dissent - the other view holding it was the merit of the land, not the move.

claim_en: THE PROMISE CLAUSES OF OUR 12:2 STRUCTURE A STANDING PRAYER. Reish Lakish maps the verse's clauses onto the opening blessing of the daily prayer, clause by clause: 'I will make you a great nation' yields 'God of Abraham', 'I will bless you' yields 'God of Isaac', 'I will make your name great' yields 'God of Jacob'. Separately the verse's three greatnesses and four blessings are counted as the three patriarchs and four matriarchs, and the three promises are read as repairing in order the three things travel diminishes - procreation, means and name.

claim_en: A REGIME CHANGE IN HOW THE WORLD IS JUDGED IS DATED TO THIS UNIT. Before this call the world was judged by catastrophe - the flood drowned, the tower generation dispersed, Sodom burned. From this man onward, chastisements replace catastrophes, and the stated proof is our own 12:10: the famine that meets him at the moment of departure. The unit's first affliction is read as evidence that the governing mode itself has changed.
